model_result.answer_summary: T5 question 5.1: tick (b) — n is an odd number. Nitrogen-free double counting of fragment valences and transferable (acidic) hydrogens over the stipulated quantities (2 phosphoric acid, 3 glycerol, 4 fatty acyl, n hydrogen fragments for non-ionised cardiolipin PL1) gives 2·(2a+n) = 2a+3b+c+n, hence n + 2a = 3b + c, so n ≡ 3b + c (mod 2). With a=2, b=3, c=4 this forces n = 9, in particular n is odd; (a) and (c) are excluded. Only the two condensation/valence balance equations (each grounded in the fragment drawings and the worked W example on the problem page) are assumed; no connectivity, chirality or peroxide information is needed.
assumptions: Fragment readings from T5 page 1 figure: phosphate fragment carries 2 free valences and 2 acidic (P-OH) protons; glycerol 3 valences; fatty acyl 1 valence; hydrogen fragment caps 1 valence and supplies no acidic proton.

Condensation stoichiometry: every inter-fragment bond is formed by elimination of H2O, consuming exactly 1 transferable hydrogen and exactly 2 free valences (grounded in the worked assembly example W on the same page).
Stipulated quantities for PL1 assembly: 2 phosphate, 3 glycerol, 4 fatty acyl, n hydrogen fragments (from the figure under 'Using only the structural elements a-d in the quantities stated below').
Standard Lean logical axioms only: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
